nodes.description: Mapping of address to token balance; updated in constructor, transfer, transferFrom, mint and burn.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; updated in approve, transferFrom, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
Total token supply; set in constructor and mutated in mint and burn.
Token name string, set in constructor and read by name().
Token symbol string, set in constructor and read by symbol().
Owner address set in constructor and checked by mint access control.
Deploys MCFToken, mints the entire supply to msg.sender and sets owner.
Returns token name from _name.
Returns token symbol from _symbol.
Returns fixed decimals value 10.
Returns _totalSupply.
Returns balance for the given account from _balances.
Transfers amount from msg.sender to recipient using unchecked-style balance arithmetic (no allowance).
Returns remaining allowance of spender for owner.
Sets allowance of spender for msg.sender to amount.
Transfers amount from sender to recipient, decrementing allowance of msg.sender without an explicit sufficiency check.
Increases allowance of spender for msg.sender by addedValue.
Decreases allowance of spender for msg.sender by subtractedValue, clamping to zero if too large.
Owner-only mint: requires msg.sender == _owner, then credits user balance and increases total supply.
Burns amount from msg.sender balance and decreases total supply.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance bookkeeping across the contract.
Subtraction of amount from _balances[msg.sender] in transfer; susceptible to underflow if arithmetic checks are weakened.
Addition of amount to _balances[recipient] in transfer; susceptible to overflow.
Access control check require(msg.sender == _owner) gating privilege minting.
Subtraction of amount from _allowances[sender][msg.sender] in transferFrom without an explicit allowance sufficiency check.
Subtraction of amount from _totalSupply and _balances[msg.sender] in burn; susceptible to underflow.
Multiplication totalSupply * (10 ** uint256(10)) used to scale the initial supply in the constructor.
Constructor parameter name_ assigned to _name.
Constructor parameter symbol_ assigned to _symbol.
Constructor parameter totalSupply used to compute the initial supply.
Account whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Recipient address credited in transfer.
Amount moved in transfer and subtracted/added to balances.
Owner address used to look up allowance.
Spender address used to look up allowance.
Spender address granted an allowance in approve.
Allowance value written by approve.
Address whose allowance and balance are debited in transferFrom.
Address credited in transferFrom.
Amount moved and deducted from allowance in transferFrom.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Value added to the spender allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Value subtracted from the spender allowance.
Address receiving newly minted tokens.
Amount of tokens minted to user and added to total supply.
Amount of tokens burned from msg.sender.
Addition of addedValue to _allowances[msg.sender][spender]; susceptible to overflow.
Subtraction of subtractedValue from _allowances[msg.sender][spender] guarded by an explicit comparison clamp.
Addition of amount to _balances[user] and _totalSupply in mint; susceptible to overflow.

edges.reason: Constructor uses msg.sender to assign initial balance and to set _owner.
transfer debits _balances indexed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender as owner.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance deduction.
increaseAllowance updates allowance for msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance updates allowance for msg.sender.
mint authorization depends on msg.sender being equal to _owner.
burn debits _balances indexed by msg.sender.
msg.sender selects the balance slot being subtracted in transfer.
msg.sender is the value compared against _owner in the mint require.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance slot decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the balance owner debited in burn.
msg.sender receives the scaled supply computed by the constructor multiplication.
msg.sender indexes the allowance slot incremented in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender indexes the allowance slot decremented in decreaseAllowance.
